findings.title: Oracle Critical Patch Update Advisory - January 2026
findings.summary_md: Oracle's January 2026 Critical Patch Update, dated January 20, 2026, lists CVE-2026-21962 in the Oracle Fusion Middleware risk matrix for the Weblogic Server Proxy Plug-in for Apache HTTP Server and for IIS, affecting versions 12.2.1.4.0, 14.1.1.0.0, and 14.1.2.0.0 (IIS plug-in only 12.2.1.4.0). Oracle rates it CVSS 3.1 base 10.0, remotely exploitable over HTTP without authentication, with a changed scope. The modification history shows Rev 2 on January 22, 2026 and Rev 3 on February 2, 2026.

findings.title: NVD record for CVE-2026-21962
findings.summary_md: NVD published the CVE-2026-21962 record on January 20, 2026 with a CVSS 3.1 base score of 10.0 (AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N): an easily exploited, unauthenticated network vector over HTTP with high confidentiality and integrity impact and changed scope. CISA's SSVC decision points in the record mark exploitation as active and automatable with total technical impact. References include the Oracle advisory and a GitHub PoC repository that has since been removed.

findings.title: Archived GitHub issue accusing the CVE-2026-21962 PoC repository of publishing fake exploits
findings.summary_md: A Wayback capture of GitHub issue #1 on the Ashwesker/Ashwesker-CVE-2026-21962 repository, opened January 22, 2026 by Chocapikk, publicly accuses the repo of posting fake PoCs for the CVE. The issue drew more than 35 upvote reactions. This dates the public PoC controversy around the exploit code circulating one day after the Cyber Centre recorded PoC availability on January 21, 2026; the underlying repository now returns 404.
